findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "save_plan_draft" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Saves a founder’s review as a one-day draft and returns a link that opens it on programscape.com with their answers and kept programs in place. The founder save…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_route, report_balance, partner_perks_admin · Private data: update_my_plan, report_balance, portfolio_perks, save_plan_draft, search_programs, get_program · Public sink: report_balance, save_plan_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_route, report_balance, partner_perks_admin · Private data: update_my_plan, report_balance, portfolio_perks, save_plan_draft, search_programs, get_program · Public sink: report_balance, save_plan_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "build_route" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
